tui.tool_card.extra.compose.composed.note: The size record on a tool row whose call the model was still writing (dictating) when it stopped. {size} is a pre-formatted byte size such as '12.4 KB' — insert it unchanged. This fact is what survives when the row narrows: the leading 'never sent' label is shed whole first, so keep it short.

tui.tool_card.extra.compose.composing.note: Summary of a tool row while the model is still writing the call's arguments. {facts} is a pre-formatted size and/or clock such as '12.4 KB · 0:42' — insert it unchanged. The leading word is shed whole at narrow widths so only {facts} remain; keep the ellipsis glyph (…) or the locale's own equivalent. 'composing', not 'writing': 'write' is a tool name in this app.

tui.tool_card.extra.compose.never_sent.note: Summary of a tool row whose call was never sent to the tool (the turn ended while the model was still writing it). {facts} is tui.tool_card.extra.compose.composed or .nothing_composed, already translated — insert it unchanged. The ' · ' separator is the row's field separator; keep it. Shed whole at narrow widths, leaving only {facts}.

tui.tool_card.extra.compose.nothing_comp.note: The size record of a never-sent tool call when no argument bytes had arrived yet. Replaces '{size} composed' in that case, so it should read as the same kind of fact with no size.

tui.tool_card.extra.fetch.attempts.note: On a web-fetch card's 'Rendered:' row: the page took this many tries (only shown for 2 or more). {count} selects the plural; {shown} is the same number as raw digits — insert {shown}, do not localise digits. Painted in the highlight colour because it explains why a slow fetch succeeded.

tui.tool_card.extra.fetch.attempts_profi.note: Same as tui.tool_card.extra.fetch.attempts, plus the sequence of browser identities the fetch used. {profiles} is a comma-separated list of technical identity names such as 'default, browser-profile' — insert it unchanged. Use the locale's own parentheses if they differ.

tui.tool_card.extra.fetch.lines.note: On a web-fetch card's 'Rendered:' row: the rendered page is this many lines long. {count} selects the plural; {shown} is the same number as raw digits — insert {shown}, do not localise digits.

tui.tool_card.extra.search.provider.note: First row of an expanded web-search card. {provider} is the search provider's technical name (e.g. 'brave', 'tavily') — insert unchanged. Label then value, like tui.tool_card.fetch.fetched; use the locale's own colon.

tui.tool_card.extra.search.provider_auth.note: Same as tui.tool_card.extra.search.provider when the provider reports how it authenticated. {auth_mode} is a technical token (e.g. 'api_key') — insert unchanged. Use the locale's own parentheses if they differ.

tui.tool_card.extra.search.sources.note: Second row of an expanded web-search card, heading the numbered list of result pages below it. Use the locale's own colon.

tui.tool_card.extra.search.untitled.note: Stands in for a web-search result's page title when the provider returned none. Shown in the numbered results list in place of a page title.

tui.tool_card.extra.send.failed_reason.note: Status slot of a FAILED `send` row. {word} is tui.tool_card.status.send.not_delivered, already translated; {cause} is the delivery failure cause from the harness (English technical text) — insert both unchanged. When the slot is narrow the cause is cut first and the word kept whole, so keep {word} first. The pattern exists so a locale can use its own separator (e.g. a full-width colon '：' in Chinese).

tui.tool_card.extra.send.mode.now.note: Leads the collapsed row of a `send` (message to another agent session) that STEERS the peer mid-turn: the message is injected into the turn it is running now. Followed by ' · ' and the target. The row truncates from the right, so keep it one short word. Distinct from .wake and .quiet.

tui.tool_card.extra.send.mode.quiet.note: Leads the collapsed row of a `send` that drops the message in the peer's mailbox WITHOUT starting a turn: the peer reads it on its next turn. Followed by ' · ' and the target. Keep it one short word. Distinct from .wake and .now.

tui.tool_card.extra.send.mode.wake.note: Leads the collapsed row of a `send` that WAKES an idle peer session so it answers right away (the default). Followed by ' · ' and the target. Keep it one short word, and keep it consistent with tui.tool_card.status.send.wake_unconfirmed. Distinct from .quiet and .now.

tui.tool_card.extra.send.model.note: Leads the collapsed row of a `send` that SWITCHES another session's model (instead of a delivery-mode marker), followed by ' · <target> · → <model id>'. Replaced by the outcome word (tui.tool_card.status.switch.*) once the call settles. Means the AI model, not a template.
